author: sascha
name: Store todos in separate files and support concurrent board editing without data loss
description:
Scope: the local idea/todo app in todo/, including storage, server API, browser behavior, tests, PROCESS.md, README.md, and generated AI/human briefings.

Support a human adding ideas while multiple agents work on different todos. Keep ideas together in one JSON file and store todos in a subfolder with one JSON file per stable todo ID. Assume one assigned agent per todo as the normal workflow, but still detect accidental same-todo or human/agent conflicts. Preserve existing fields, original ideas and attribution, IDs, source_ideas links, statuses, timestamps, implementation references, and unrelated data.

The current implementation uses a whole-board /api/state snapshot, global SHA-256 revision checking, a server lock, and atomic replacement. Retain the protection against stale writes while removing unnecessary whole-board conflicts: independent todo edits and idea additions must not replace or invalidate unrelated records. File separation alone is insufficient. Design record-scoped mutation and revision checks, atomic writes, collision-safe ID allocation and creation, and consistent read/validation behavior. Reject conflicting stale edits explicitly; preserve the user's draft and provide a clear way to reload, compare, and reconcile only intended changes. Never silently use last-writer-wins or retry an entire stale snapshot under a new revision.

Provide a lossless migration from the current version-1 data.json. Establish a safe migration window, retain a recoverable original, validate all migrated records and references, and define interruption recovery and repeat-run behavior. Avoid two competing authoritative stores or old clients silently writing obsolete data after migration. Cover idea processing races, including ID allocation and duplicate todo creation for the same source idea. Define how cross-file operations remain recoverable without losing or orphaning records. Keep the local standard-library/no-build approach unless a justified change is separately authorized.

Update the UI and all relevant API consumers for the new storage contract while preserving board features and unsaved drafts during refreshes. Update PROCESS.md and startup/storage documentation with exact authoritative paths, safe writes while the server is running or stopped, conflict detection/reconciliation, assignment coordination, and migration/recovery instructions. Update AI and human briefings to direct workers to re-read the latest individual todo and original ideas, change only their assigned record, follow the revision protocol, and report ownership/conflicts rather than overwrite another worker. Briefing snapshots must not become a second source of truth.

Acceptance: using temporary fixtures, demonstrate a human adding an idea concurrently with two agents updating different todos, with every edit retained; same-record stale edits are rejected with a recoverable draft; concurrent creation/processing cannot reuse IDs or silently duplicate work; migration preserves all records/fields and handles reruns and interruption; failed writes leave valid recoverable data. Verify existing UI workflows and both briefing types against the new contract. Never test races or failure injection against the live board.

Resolve during design: exact filenames and schema version, endpoint/revision format, ID allocation mechanism, lightweight ownership signaling, and recovery protocol for multi-record changes. The requirement is separate todo files and no silent data loss, not a preselected locking or database architecture. Migration must follow the currently applicable safe-update process until the new process is implemented and verified.

2026-09-06 addition from sascha: automatically commit meaningful saved task/idea changes to local Git (never push), including human edits and status changes. Explain implementation, practicality, and possible improvements.

2026-09-06 completed by Codex: migrated the live board losslessly to schema-2 ideas plus todos/<ID>.json, retained exact data.v1-backup.json, and restarted the server. Record revisions isolate independent edits; server allocation and shared-source checks detect creation/processing races; durable journals and request receipts recover interrupted writes and uncertain retries. OS directory lock coordinates servers/offline commands. Updated browser draft preservation, AI/human briefings, README, and PROCESS.md. Meaningful saves synchronously create data-only local Git commits; no-op/timestamp-only saves do not. Git failures retain saved data with a persistent warning/retry and block further meaningful edits until history succeeds. No push operations. Validation: 36 temporary-board tests passed, including concurrency, migration interruption, same-record rejection, duplicate processing, idempotency, Git failure/retry and unrelated staged-file exclusion. Browser verified idea creation, todo creation, text saves, closure, both briefings, and preserved conflict drafts. JavaScript syntax and git diff whitespace checks passed. Limitations: single working-tree coordination, manual worker assignment via progress notes, synchronous Git latency and unbounded receipt retention; Windows lock branch not exercised on this macOS host. Code changes are in the working tree; data-history commits are not implementation commit references.
